confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from several aggregated Kaohsiung and Taiwan-wide guides dated 2023 to 2026, with mixed or unlabeled currencies, converted at about 32.5 TWD per USD. Cocktail and wine-by-glass anchors are weaker: the cocktail value uses Taiwan-wide and Taipei ranges, and the wine value uses the local beer relationship (about 2x beer) because no reliable Kaohsiung glass price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from search or live listings. The FX observation (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from search-result summaries and a third-party page citing RBA data; I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable foreign city used. Restaurant and coffee anchors are based on Kaohsiung-specific guides where available, cross-checked against Taiwan-wide ranges. Beer is anchored to roughly NT$150 at bars and restaurants. Cocktail is about 2x beer, and wine glass is about 2x beer. Accommodation is a model estimate for Kaohsiung budget and mid-range hotels and hostels.
